question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Get top 3 combined points
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) as max_round
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
last_race_ids AS (
    SELECT r.race_id, r.year
    FROM races r
    JOIN last_race lr ON r.year = lr.year AND r.round = lr.max_round
),
constructor_season AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, lri.year, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_race_ids lri ON cs.race_id = lri.race_id
),
driver_season AS (
    SELECT ds.driver_id, lri.year, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_race_ids lri ON ds.race_id = lri.race_id
),
driver_constructor_year AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.year, d.constructor_id, d.driver_id
    FROM drives d
),
constructor_best_driver AS (
    SELECT ccy.constructor_id, ccy.year, cs.constructor_points,
           MAX(ds.driver_points) as best_driver_points
    FROM driver_constructor_year ccy
    JOIN constructor_season cs ON ccy.constructor_id = cs.constructor_id AND ccy.year = cs.year
    JOIN driver_season ds ON ccy.driver_id = ds.driver_id AND ccy.year = ds.year
    GROUP BY ccy.constructor_id, ccy.year, cs.constructor_points
),
combined AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, year, constructor_points, best_driver_points,
           constructor_points + best_driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_best_driver
)
SELECT c.name as constructor_name, cb.year, cb.combined_points
FROM combined cb
JOIN constructors c ON cb.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cb.combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
